definitions.gloss: chin beard; goatee; beard on the chin
definitions.explanation: Facial hair growing on the chin. Can refer to any beard on the chin area, including a goatee.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}はあごひげを{剃|そ}るのが{嫌|きら}いだ。
{立派|りっぱ}なあごひげを{蓄|たくわ}えた{老人|ろうじん}が{座|すわ}っていた。
examples.english: An old man with a splendid beard was sitting there.

notes:
Compound of あご (chin/jaw) + ひげ (facial hair). Also written {顎鬚|あごひげ} or {顎髭|あごひげ} in kanji, though the kana spelling is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- あごひげを{生|は}やす: to grow a chin beard
- あごひげを{剃|そ}る: to shave one's beard
- あごひげを{蓄|たくわ}える: to grow/keep a beard (literary)
- あごひげを{整|ととの}える: to trim one's beard

RELATED WORDS:
- ひげ: facial hair (general term) — can refer to any facial hair
- {口|くち}ひげ: mustache — hair above the upper lip
- ほおひげ: sideburns — hair on the cheeks
